title: Zagier's dimension conjecture for classical multiple zeta values
exact_target: At every weight, does the vector space of actual multiple zeta values have exactly the dimension given by Zagier's two-step recurrence?

sources.citation: Masanobu Kaneko, Masayuki Noro and Ken'ichi Tsurumaki, On a conjecture for the dimension of the space of the multiple zeta values; author-hosted version, venue/DOI not verified.
